parts.note: an opening is a start, the beginning of something
le is the French masculine word for 'the'

explanation.surface: Someone is taken aback by the way a French event opened.
explanation.definitionFit: To surprise someone suddenly is to make them jump, a close synonym.

clue.text: Didn't miss a thing about East Coast defence

indicators.note: about means going round, so one piece is placed around the other

parts.note: someone who missed nothing saw all

explanation.surface: A watchful lookout guards the eastern coastline against invasion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'East Coast' reads as one place, but East gives only the letter and 'Coast defence' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A barrier built along the shore against the waves is a coastal defence structure.

parts.note: a band is a group of musicians or people

explanation.surface: A band of soldiers is away on leave.
explanation.definitionFit: To leave something behind for good is to desert or forsake it, a verb synonym.

indicators.note: a pronouncement is something spoken, so the word is taken as it sounds

parts.note: to follow a trail is to have tracked it

explanation.surface: A leaflet is issued and then an official statement comes after it.
explanation.definitionFit: A short religious or political booklet is a pamphlet by another name.

clue.text: In a way are able to give further details

indicators.note: in a way suggests the letters are taken in some other arrangement

explanation.surface: People who can manage it in some fashion are able to expand their account.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram is of all nine letters in ARE ABLE TO.
explanation.definitionFit: To enlarge on a story with more information is to expand or develop it.

clue.text: They took over from the night-shift

definitions.text: They took over from the night-shift

parts.words: They took over from the night-shift
parts.note: the night-shift here is the old nightshirt, a garment whose place at bedtime was taken by two-piece sleepwear

explanation.surface: A day crew relieved the workers who had been on duty overnight.
explanation.definitionFit: Two-piece nightwear largely replaced the nightshirt or nightgown as bedtime clothing.

parts.note: a model works for artists by holding still positions, so the clue reads as what a model does for those who hire them

explanation.surface: Someone asks about the jobs available with exemplary firms.
explanation.definitionFit: A model's work consists of striking and holding attitudes or postures for an artist.

clue.text: Find Chinese ship's spars in the scrap dealers'?

parts.note: a junk is a traditional Chinese sailing ship
yards are the spars hung across a mast to carry sails

explanation.surface: Bits of an old Chinese vessel's rigging turn up at the scrapyard.
explanation.definitionFit: Places where scrap merchants keep their stock of discarded goods.

clue.text: Book covering part of N Africa

definitions.meaning: a fine goatskin leather used for binding books

explanation.definitionFit: The leather took its name from the North African country where it was first made.

indicators.note: in places the skill inside the bridge

parts.note: a span is a bridge or the arch of one
art is skill, as in the art of doing something

explanation.surface: Some ancient expertise in the card game bridge.
explanation.definitionFit: Sparta was an ancient Greek city-state, so its citizens belong to antiquity.

clue.text: State of a student gaining a couple of degrees

parts.note: L is the learner plate letter, used for a student
BA, Bachelor of Arts, is one degree
MA, Master of Arts, is the other degree

explanation.surface: A student's progress after earning two university qualifications.
explanation.walkthrough: Both copies of 'a' give an A: A, then L, then A, then the two degrees.
explanation.definitionFit: Alabama is one of the states of the USA, an example of the category.

clue.text: Rendered a tune in return for a drink in Spain

parts.note: to render a song is to sing it, so rendered gives sang

indicators.note: in return means the word for a tune is read backwards

parts.note: an air is a tune

explanation.surface: Someone performed a song in exchange for a drink on a Spanish holiday.
explanation.definitionFit: Sangria is a Spanish wine punch with fruit, a typical drink there.

clue.text: It is an odd, rather unusual, way to get extras

indicators.note: rather unusual tells us the letters appear in an unusual order

explanation.surface: Someone remarks that a method of getting more is somewhat strange.
explanation.definitionFit: Extras are things added on, so they are supplements or add-ons.

indicators.note: redesigned tells us the letters are rebuilt in a new order
fourth picks the fourth letter of the name

explanation.surface: The famous sailor Chay Blyth's fourth vessel has been rebuilt.
explanation.walkthrough: Chay Blyth is a British round-the-world yachtsman. 'fourth' takes T from BLYTH, which joins CHAY in the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: A sailing vessel used for racing or cruising is a kind of boat.

definitions.meaning: connecting rings in a chain, which join things together
a golf course, especially one by the sea

explanation.definitionFit: Chain loops connect things, and a seaside golf course takes the same name.

indicators.note: perhaps hints that the letters could be arranged otherwise

explanation.surface: An area looks rather like a run-down urban district.
explanation.definitionFit: To imitate or mimic something is to resemble it outwardly.

clue.text: PM comes out of No Ten for a break

indicators.note: break shows the letters are broken up and reassembled

explanation.surface: The Prime Minister leaves Number Ten for a holiday.
explanation.walkthrough: 'PM' looks like the Prime Minister at Number 10 Downing Street, but it means post meridiem, the afternoon.
explanation.definitionFit: PM stands for post meridiem, the hours after noon.

clue.text: Retaliation in kind from tart, fit to burst

indicators.note: to burst is to break apart, so the letters are scattered and reformed

explanation.surface: A tart pastry so full it is ready to explode.
explanation.definitionFit: Paying back an injury with an equal injury is the idiom for like-for-like revenge.

definitions.meaning: the holder of a church benefice, which is called a living
as in it is ... on someone, meaning obligatory

explanation.definitionFit: A vicar or rector holding a parish is the post-holder, and the adjective means obligatory.

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand
shares are portions or parts

explanation.surface: A company reveals a holding of a thousand shares.
explanation.definitionFit: To impart information is to reveal or make it known.

clue.text: Small bird needs tail bent when in bed

indicators.note: when in places the rearranged letters inside the bed

parts.note: a cot is a small bed

indicators.note: bent shows the letters of the word tail are twisted out of order

explanation.surface: A little bird tucks its tail awkwardly when roosting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bent' turns TAIL into ALTI, which goes inside COT.
explanation.definitionFit: A small dark-capped European songbird of the tit family.

definitions.meaning: as a verb, to insult or berate someone

explanation.definitionFit: Informal speech is called slang, and to slang someone in British usage is to abuse them verbally.

clue.text: Is embraced by a longing for a sweet

indicators.note: embraced by puts the first word inside the others

parts.note: a need is a longing or want

explanation.surface: A strong craving for something sugary.
explanation.definitionFit: Aniseed balls are a traditional British sweet, so the flavour stands for the sweet.

definitions.meaning: the coming into being or origin of something
the first book of the Bible

explanation.definitionFit: The word means origin or creation, and names the opening book of the Bible.

clue.text: She gets fruit by the pound

parts.note: a pear is a fruit
L is the abbreviation for pound, from Latin libra

explanation.surface: A woman buys fruit sold by weight.
explanation.definitionFit: Pearl is a woman's name, so it can stand for 'she'.

parts.note: trying here means being tested, so the clue describes the trial period a new employee serves

explanation.surface: Early days in a new pursuit can be hard going.
explanation.definitionFit: A new starter often serves an initial trial period to prove themselves.
A political organisation and a celebration share the name.

parts.note: Anne is a girl's name
X is the sign for a kiss at the end of a letter

explanation.surface: A girl joins in and gives a kiss.
explanation.definitionFit: To annex something is to attach or add it on.

clue.text: Device that still goes round with part missing

definitions.text: Device that still goes round with part missing

parts.words: Device that still goes round with part missing
parts.note: a machine part that turns; read backwards the word stays the same, so it still goes round

explanation.surface: A machine keeps turning even though a component has fallen off.
explanation.definitionFit: A rotating mechanism or muscle that turns something is named for its turning.

definitions.meaning: people who turn animal hides into leather
a tanner was the old British sixpence coin, here in the plural

explanation.definitionFit: Leather workers share their name with the old British slang for sixpence coins.

definitions.meaning: to pay or compensate in full

explanation.definitionFit: To content someone and to discharge a claim are both senses of the verb.

clue.text: Statesmen may wear them with black ties

definitions.text: Statesmen may wear them with black ties

parts.words: Statesmen may wear them with black ties
parts.note: statesmen read as States men, Americans, who call a dinner jacket by this name

explanation.surface: Politicians at a formal dinner dress in evening wear.
explanation.definitionFit: The American term for a dinner jacket worn at black-tie events.
